content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a race condition during iterations over the `adapter->afu` array in the CXL module. This race condition occurred because the array could be modified (its contents set to NULL) while it was being read in the context of error handling (e.g., during an EEH event) or when the driver was being unloaded, leading to potential NULL pointer dereferences and consequent kernel crashes (kernel oops). The patch resolves this issue by ensuring that all accesses to `adapter->afu` are protected by a spin lock (`adapter->afu_list_lock`), which prevents concurrent modifications while the array is being iterated.
